headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox edged the Detroit Tigers 4-3 in a closely contested matchup, with Eduardo Valencia leading the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs behind a dominant performance from Michael McGreevy, who pitched 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Spencer Miles earning the win.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 11, 2026, with a right forearm flexor strain. Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left wrist tendon inflammation. Davis Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister. Matt Chapman has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with an abdominal strain. Trevor McDonald has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. Garrett Whitlock has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, with right elbow inflammation.

The Milwaukee Brewers have bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, who was traded to the team from the Athletics for cash. The Athletics traded Ornelas in exchange for cash. The Boston Red Sox traded CF Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles as part of the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade.
